business_failure.grouped_margin_error: Four ANET gross-margin observations (quarter/current, quarter/prior, half-year/current, half-year/prior) collapsed into three candidates with labels such as 2025 2026; the 62.4% half-year current value was not eligible.
business_failure.cash_role_error: ANET cash and cash equivalents at June 30, 2026 was labelled qtd although a bare balance-sheet date denotes an instant.
business_failure.root_cause: The same year-row predicate served both pure second-header skipping and grouped year-plus-change expansion. Tightening it for the first use disabled the second. Separately, bare date columns lacked an explicit instant rule.
business_failure.meaning: All values still came from the right filing, but period coordinates no longer told a researcher which margin was quarterly versus half-year and whether cash was a stock. Those objects cannot enter an index.

decision_zh: R6 恢复了 ASML 销售额并补齐期间角色，但 ANET 分组季度／半年毛利率坐标和裸日期现金角色仍不正确，因此不得进入索引。下一 Attempt 只拆分纯年份表头与分组年份表头判定，并把独立日期列判为时点。
known_boundary: This is a local table-coordinate semantic defect found before any sparse/dense build. It is not a source, BGE, Milvus, DeepSeek, rerank or external-search failure.
